changelog: Sales boards: the rep strip shows each colleague's load as a small badge (open count, and a red dot with the overdue count when there is one); the full load opens in a popover on hover, keyboard focus or tap (#3988).

en: The rep strip above the board is tidier: next to each name a small badge shows the open leads, with a red dot and number for overdue follow-ups. Hover or tap it for the details.
tr: Panonun üstündeki temsilci şeridi sadeleşti: her ismin yanında açık lead sayısını gösteren küçük bir rozet, gecikmiş takip varsa kırmızı nokta ve sayısı var. Ayrıntı için üzerine gelin veya dokunun.
de: Die Teamleiste über dem Board ist aufgeräumter: Neben jedem Namen zeigt ein kleines Abzeichen die offenen Leads, bei überfälligen Wiedervorlagen mit rotem Punkt und Anzahl. Details per Mauszeiger oder Antippen.
